beats.what: Establishing shot. Date scroll '13 FEBRUARY 1951'. Labels CHIPYONG-NI, TO YONGMUN, TO KOKSU-RI.
Blue ~1-mile perimeter draws on. Counters 1/23, 2/23, 3/23 INF, FR BN, 37 FA drop in. Stake plaques COL. PAUL FREEMAN and GEN. RIDGWAY ('ORDER: HOLD').
8 CCF counters appear outside; red arrows draw inward; red dashed encirclement closes and pulses. Caption: SURROUNDED BY 5 CHINESE DIVISIONS.
C-119 Flying Boxcar crosses west to east, drops 3 parachutes into the ring. Caption: RESUPPLIED FROM THE AIR.
Date flips to '15 FEBRUARY 1951'. TF CROMBEZ arrow pushes north from Koksu-ri road, tank counter follows it and breaks the ring. Caption: 23 TANKS BREAK THROUGH.
CCF counters fade to grey, arrows withdraw. End card: SIEGE BROKEN - ~5,000 Chinese casualties - 52 defenders killed.
